title: Irish Beef Stew
description: A hearty and comforting Irish beef stew made with tender chunks of beef and fresh vegetables.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove from pot and set aside.
Add the onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the carrots and potatoes to the pot and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the flour to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the browned beef back into the pot, along with the salt, pepper, and thyme.
Add the red wine and beef broth to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh thyme.
